description.en: Unofficial community app — not affiliated with, endorsed by, or supported by Cummins Inc. Monitor and control Cummins home standby generators: via Cummins Connect Cloud (QuietConnect) or the local web interface on older RS-series models.

hint.en: The generator hasn't checked in to Cummins Connect Cloud for longer than the configured threshold — it may be offline.
No self-test has completed within the configured threshold.

titleFormatted.en: The battery voltage dropped below [[voltage]] V

hint.en: Fires once when the starter battery voltage crosses below the threshold. The battery starts the generator — a weak battery means no backup power when you need it.
Fires for every new event in the generator's cloud event history (faults, exercises, state changes).
The generator's front panel is asking for attention.

title.en: The generator !{{has|doesn't have}} an active fault

hint.en: Poll Cummins Connect Cloud immediately instead of waiting for the next scheduled poll.
Sends StartGenset to Cummins Connect Cloud. Requires "Enable remote start/stop" in the device settings and remote control enabled on the generator itself.
Sends StopGenset to Cummins Connect Cloud. Requires "Enable remote start/stop" in the device settings and remote control enabled on the generator itself.
Starts the same self-test cycle the generator runs on its schedule.
Sends FaultReset. Only clears the fault indication — it does not fix the underlying cause.
Starts the engine via the generator's local interface. The generator's switch must be in REMOTE.
Stops the engine via the generator's local interface. The generator's switch must be in REMOTE.
Arms the generator so it will auto-start on a utility outage.
Disarms auto-start. The generator will NOT start automatically during an outage while disabled.

title.en: Sign in to Cummins Connect Cloud
Sign in again to Cummins Connect Cloud

hint.en: How often to fetch telemetry from Cummins Connect Cloud. The generator itself only checks in periodically, so faster polling mostly adds load, not freshness.
Raise the 'Data stale' alarm when the generator hasn't checked in to the cloud for this long. 25 hours catches a missed daily check-in.
Raise the 'Exercise overdue' alarm when no self-test has completed for this long. 8 days catches a missed weekly exercise.
Set your generator's nameplate rating (e.g. 20 for an RS20A) to estimate power output and energy produced from the reported load percentage. Leave at 0 to disable those two values.

Adds an on/off switch to the device and enables the start/stop Flow cards. These start and stop a real engine, and also require remote control to be enabled on the generator itself. Running an exercise and clearing a fault do not need this setting.

label.en: Post critical events to the Homey timeline

hint.en: Adds a timeline entry when utility power is lost, the house switches to generator power, or a fault occurs. Flow cards give you finer control; this is the zero-setup version.
Undecoded integer from the cloud API. If you can correlate values with what the Cummins app shows, please report the mapping.

desc.en: Start an exercise (self-test) cycle now. The generator's switch must be in REMOTE.
Sets the generator's internal clock to Homey's current time.

label.en: Check event/fault logs every N polls

hint.en: The event and fault logs are separate pages on the generator's web server; they change rarely, so they are fetched less often than live status.
Set your generator's nameplate rating (e.g. 20 for an RS20A) to estimate power output and energy produced from the reported load percentage. Leave at 0 to disable those two values.
When the generator's clock drifts more than the threshold from Homey's time, set it automatically (like the HA bridge's nightly time sync).

label.en: Post critical events to the Homey timeline

hint.en: Adds a timeline entry when utility power is lost, the house switches to generator power, or a fault occurs. Flow cards give you finer control; this is the zero-setup version.
Written to the generator when you save. Reads back from the generator otherwise. Requires the generator's switch to be in REMOTE.
